note: Per-page localization budgets, enforced by scripts/audit-i18n-chunks.ts after pnpm build. maxMessages counts compiled Paraglide message bodies a page downloads; maxGzip is the gzipped size of the chunks carrying them. Lowering a number is always allowed. Raising one needs a reason in the PR: it means a page started paying for copy it does not render. See docs/i18n-bundle-plan.md.

surfaces.justification: gzip is ~650 B above the pre-split baseline while message count fell 109 -> 69: the landing copy now lives in its own route chunk instead of a shared one, so it compresses against a smaller dictionary. Every other marketing page dropped 4+ KB gzip, so the trade is strongly net-positive. Raised 8739 -> 9262 after 7277e93 added surah-data loading to the marketing landing route: the route node carries landing's Paraglide messages, so the non-i18n surah code inflated the message-bearing chunk's gzip. Message count stayed flat at 69 (no copy the page does not render), so this is real route growth, not localization drift.
